events.title: CHHATTISGARH RISING | TRIPLE E
events.subtitle: Entertainment · Education · Entrepreneurship
events.shortDescription: Chhattisgarh Rising | Triple E is a proposed conclave in Raipur bringing together entertainment, education and entrepreneurship, with inspiring speakers, youth initiatives and investment conversations.
events.description:
A landmark platform bringing together India's influential voices, emerging talent, business leaders, investors, educators and creative minds to shape the future of Chhattisgarh.

**A new platform. Three powerful dimensions. One rising Chhattisgarh.**

Chhattisgarh Rising | Triple E is envisioned as a major one-day conclave bringing together Entertainment, Education and Entrepreneurship on a common platform.

The initiative aims to celebrate the state's talent, inspire its youth, showcase its creative potential and create meaningful conversations around business, investment, innovation and emerging opportunities.

With influential personalities from cinema, education and business, along with entrepreneurs, investors, artists, creators, students and policymakers, the conclave is expected to connect Chhattisgarh with new ideas, new possibilities and a wider national platform.

The gathering is expected to bring together approximately 1,500 to 2,000 participants, including students, young professionals, entrepreneurs, business leaders, investors, artists, educators, media professionals and industry representatives, subject to final registration and venue arrangements.

sections.heading: Three pillars. One big vision.
sections.subtitle: Entertainment, education and entrepreneurship on one platform.
sections.body:
**1. Entertainment**

Taking Chhattisgarh's stories to the national stage.

A platform for cinema, creativity, regional storytelling, local talent and the state's potential as a film and content destination.

This segment is planned to explore Chhattisgarh as a place for film and content, opportunities for local artists and technicians, and the role of cinema in shaping the state's identity.

Proposed conversations would bring together filmmakers, actors, creators, influencers and media professionals.

**2. Education**

Inspiring young minds. Creating new possibilities.

An opportunity for students and young people to meet inspiring personalities, learn from real-life journeys and discover new pathways.

Through proposed masterclasses and interactive sessions, this segment is planned around aspiration, access to opportunity, perseverance, skill development and the power of learning.

**3. Entrepreneurship**

Connecting ideas with investment and opportunity.

A platform for entrepreneurs, investors, companies, startups and business leaders to explore Chhattisgarh's emerging opportunities.

The discussions are planned around investment potential, innovation, technology, renewable energy, manufacturing, digital infrastructure, sports, fitness, wellness and local enterprise.

sections.heading: Bastar Rising
sections.subtitle: Beyond the conclave. Towards positive transformation.
sections.body:
Bastar Rising is a proposed special youth initiative exploring the power of fitness, martial arts, discipline and confidence building.

The concept includes a proposed one- to two-day outreach and masterclass with Vidyut Jammwal in Bastar, engaging tribal youth, students and people rebuilding their lives after leaving Naxal-affected environments and choosing to reconnect with mainstream society.

The initiative aims to encourage self-confidence, mental resilience, teamwork, physical fitness and positive life choices. It is envisioned as a meaningful effort to connect inspiration with grassroots transformation.

The proposed visit and masterclass remain subject to formal confirmation, government coordination, security arrangements and operational approvals.

sections.heading: Investment and emerging industries summit
sections.subtitle: Bringing business, ideas and opportunities together.
sections.body:
A dedicated segment is planned for business owners, investors, companies, sector experts and entrepreneurs to explore Chhattisgarh's potential and discuss opportunities in:

- Solar and renewable energy
- Data centres and digital infrastructure
- Artificial intelligence, robotics and emerging technology
- Sports, fitness and wellness
- Manufacturing and allied industries
- Food processing, logistics and local enterprise

The proposed format includes business presentations, sector conversations, investor networking and project showcases.

This is a conversation platform. It does not guarantee government meetings, approvals or MoUs. Any investment proposal or MoU announcement will remain subject to independent negotiations and approvals by the concerned parties and competent authorities.

sections.heading: Why Chhattisgarh Rising?
sections.subtitle: A state's future is shaped by its people, ideas, talent and opportunities.
sections.body:
Chhattisgarh Rising aims to connect young people with role models, give local talent wider visibility, help entrepreneurs discover potential partners, and create a stronger national conversation around the state's possibilities.

- Young people meet inspiring role models.
- Local talent gets wider visibility.
- Entrepreneurs connect with potential partners and investors.
- Businesses discover emerging opportunities.
- Filmmakers and creators explore new possibilities.
- Chhattisgarh's achievements and aspirations reach a wider audience.
